timestamp.basis: Regulation (EU) No 910/2014, art. 41 (as amended by Regulation (EU) 2024/1183)
timestamp.qualified_recognition: A qualified electronic time stamp enjoys the presumption of the accuracy of the date and time it indicates and of the integrity of the data to which they are bound; it is recognised as qualified in all Member States. National implementing rules not verified.

open_questions: Research not completed for Greece: the session's web-search budget (200 calls) was exhausted before Greek sources could be located, and no per-article official text (et.gr gazette PDFs or the national codification portal) could be reached by direct fetch. Every national field below remains unverified.

Criminal route to verify: Κώδικας Ποινικής Δικονομίας (ν. 4620/2019, ΦΕΚ Α' 96/2019 as amended) chapter on πραγματογνωμοσύνη and τεχνικοί σύμβουλοι - appointment from court lists, oath, questions set by the investigating authority, contents and deadline of the έκθεση πραγματογνωμοσύνης, challenge grounds.

Civil route to verify: Κώδικας Πολιτικής Δικονομίας chapter on πραγματογνωμοσύνη (approximately art. 368-393) - appointment, oath, written report (γνωμοδότηση), party technical advisers (τεχνικοί σύμβουλοι).

Liability to verify: Ποινικός Κώδικας (ν. 4619/2019) provision punishing a false expert opinion (ψευδής πραγματογνωμοσύνη / perjury provisions applied to experts) with its penalty, and any disciplinary rules for listed experts.
Expert oath or declaration formula (όρκος / δήλωση πραγματογνώμονα) and whether it must appear in the written report: not verified.

Electronic signature: national implementing provisions (expected in ν. 4727/2020 on digital governance; terms εγκεκριμένη / προηγμένη ηλεκτρονική υπογραφή and ηλεκτρονική χρονοσφραγίδα) not verified on an official source.
Standards: ELOT national adoption of EN ISO/IEC 27037/27041/27042/27043 not verified.
